question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is **disappointed.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• **Disappointed: **sad because you/somebody/something did not succeed or because something was not as good, interesting, etc. as you had hoped. ((विफलता या आशा के अनुरूप न होने के कारण) निराश)

 
 
• **Example: **Sourav was deeply *disappointed* at not being chosen for the team.
